title: Rust: BLE platform binding (btleplug/embassy-nrf)
description: Acceptance: btleplug or embassy-nrf integration works
notes: 2026-08-27 completed in rust/lichen-kiss: added a bounded no_std async BleGattBackend/BleTncLink lifecycle abstraction with atomic connect failure, guarded write/receive, 512-byte limits, backend length validation, disconnect state cleanup, and focused async mocks. Added opt-in kiss-ble-btleplug host backend for adapter discovery, service-filtered scanning, KISS TX/RX characteristic/property discovery, RX subscription, bounded writes/notifications with timeouts, cleanup on discovery/subscribe failure, and disconnect. Heavy OS BLE dependencies remain fully optional and do not enter kiss-ble/no_std builds. embassy-nrf was intentionally not added because it is a HAL/executor, not a BLE host/GATT implementation. Validation passed: cargo fmt --check; cargo test -p lichen-kiss --features kiss-ble --lib (7/7); cargo check no-default-features kiss-ble; cargo check kiss-ble-btleplug on macOS/CoreBluetooth; cargo clippy all-targets kiss-ble-btleplug -D warnings; diff check. Host backend test artifact also compiled; physical-controller interaction was not required by the mocked acceptance run.
